surface_function: A serene monastery sanctuary at the town's northern edge. White stone, soft light, the stilling bell. Peace that feels real because it is — and because someone is working very hard to keep it that way.
hidden_function: The peace is curated, not organic. Nothing decays here because nothing is allowed to. Deep beneath the cloister, an Ashen Covenant confessional proves the two factions were once one.

veil_state_moods.still: Waiting. The mirrors hold fewer reflections.
veil_state_moods.storm: The bell rings loud. Peace requires effort.
veil_state_moods.quasar_active: The bell falls silent. The mirrors break. The confessional appears.
